after.heldReason:
the conflict is not resolved: Pull request #104 conflicts with main, and a rebase session could not resolve it: main.go

Rebase the branch onto origin/main, resolve the conflicts keeping both sides' intent, make the acceptance check pass again, and push with --force-with-lease; the pull request updates itself.
after.holdHolder: the integrator's rebase of pull request #104 onto its base
after.holdRecovery: refused twice on the same head: the builder cannot resolve a conflict it is told to leave to a rebase, so a rebase session is requested; a new head on the branch or a moved base releases it, and a person is named if the rebase fails or at hold_deadline
